'''Thalo Terrix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was a high-ranking member of the [[Justicars' Brigade]], a vigilante militia that controlled a [[Justicar territory|portion]] of Coruscant. He was killed by a Republic-allied individual who was pushing back the Justicars' forces from the territory.

==Behind the scenes==
Thalo Terrix was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
